A day for each feast

Independence Day (United States)

A Homegrown Fourth of July Celebration

Embrace the spirit of Independence Day right from your backyard with a day filled with delicious food, cherished traditions, and dazzling displays.

  1. Morning

    A Patriotic Start

    Begin your day by reflecting on the nation's founding. You might read excerpts from the Declaration of Independence aloud with family, just as it was done in 1776.

  2. Late Morning

    Refreshing Brews

    Prepare a pitcher of classic American beverages to keep everyone cool and hydrated throughout the day's festivities.

    Recipes: Classic Independence Day Lemonade · Classic Sweet Tea

  3. Early Afternoon

    Grill Prep & Sides

    Get your grill ready and start preparing the delicious side dishes that complement any Fourth of July feast.

    Recipes: Classic Independence Day Baked Beans · Classic Grilled Corn on the Cob

  4. Mid-Afternoon

    Backyard BBQ Begins!

    Fire up the grill and cook up the quintessential Independence Day main courses. The aroma will surely get everyone excited for dinner.

    Recipes: Classic Independence Day Beef Burgers · Classic Grilled Independence Day Hot Dogs

  5. Dinner Time

    The Grand Feast

    Gather your loved ones for a festive meal, enjoying all the delicious food you've prepared together, celebrating American culinary traditions.

    Recipes: Classic Independence Day Beef Burgers · Classic Grilled Independence Day Hot Dogs · Classic Grilled Corn on the Cob · Classic Independence Day Baked Beans · Classic Independence Day Lemonade · Classic Sweet Tea

  6. Evening

    Sweet Endings

    As dusk approaches, indulge in a classic American dessert, perfect for a summer evening.

    Recipes: Classic Independence Day Berry Pie

  7. Sundown

    Fireworks Finale

    Conclude your day with a spectacular view of fireworks, whether from your backyard or a local display, celebrating the brilliant spirit of the nation.

May your Independence Day be filled with joy, delicious food, and cherished memories with those you hold dear.
